questions.q: Where do most of the header fields on Dana's new requisition come from?
options: Dana must type every header field manually from a blank form
They are copied from the previous requester's requisition
They default automatically from her own employee and user setup, such as her requisitioning business unit
A system administrator enters them for every requisition
questions.explain: Header fields like requester, requisitioning BU, and deliver-to location default from the requester's own setup rather than being typed in each time.

questions.q: Why does Dana not need to know or guess Meridian's price for the bearing?
options: Because prices are never shown to requesters
Because requisitions never include pricing information
Because the price is only determined after the invoice is received
Because the PB-4400 catalog entry already carries a pre-negotiated unit price, so the estimated amount calculates automatically
questions.explain: Catalog items carry a known price, so adding quantity 50 to the catalog line calculates the estimated amount without Dana entering a price.

questions.q: What does the need-by date on a requisition line later become on the purchase order?
options: The expected delivery date the buyer considers when committing to a supplier
The invoice due date
The requisition approval deadline
The payment terms
questions.explain: The need-by date carries forward as the expected delivery date, which a buyer checks before committing to a supplier.

questions.q: What is the status of Dana's requisition immediately after she clicks submit?
options: Paid
Pending Approval, with no effect yet on the supplier
Closed
Automatically converted into a purchase order with the supplier notified
questions.explain: Submitting assigns a requisition number and status Pending Approval, routing it into the approval workflow - it does not yet involve the supplier.

questions.q: What does the deliver-to location on a requisition line set up for later in this transaction?
options: The receiving location Priya will use when the shipment arrives
The supplier's remittance address
The GL account used for payment
The approval routing rule applied to the requisition
questions.explain: The deliver-to location on the requisition line identifies where the shipment should physically go, which becomes the receiving location used later in Chapter 4.
